```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

The purpose of his script is to determine is any SFARI genes are included in the signficiant TT genes for males.

##Load Packages

```{r load package}
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(readxl)
library(Signac)
library(glue)
library(cowplot)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(patchwork)
library(Matrix)

set.seed(123)
```

## Import data

```{r import SFARI gene list and TT results}
SFARI_Gene <- read_csv("../../doc/targeted/SFARI-Gene_genes_07-08-2025release_07-22-2025export.csv", col_types = cols(status = col_skip()))
```


```{r filter gene list}

SFARI_Gene <- SFARI_Gene %>% dplyr::filter(`gene-score` <= 1)
```
